svg.title: Draw it yourself: Week 32
svg.desc: A large empty framed panel with a dashed inner border and faint centre text reading your chart here. The prompt asks the learner to plot six pairs of their own numbers, lay a ruler through the middle of them, draw the line, mark a step triangle on it and write the slope with both of its units.
svg.text: Six pairs of your own numbers, one ruler, one line, one step triangle.
Label both axes with units. Write the slope as a sentence: “each extra ____ goes with about ____ more ____”.
